- *Customer Resolutions are Allowed*
- *Customer Corpse Count is NOT Allowed*

- *Infinite Death Machine is NOT Allowed*
- *Prolonging any special weapons usage is NOT Allowed*
- *Glitching attachments for any weapon are NOT Allowed*
- *Zombie Counter is NOT Allowed*
- *Health Meters of any kind are NOT Allowed*
- *Injection is NOT Allowed*
- *Transparent Textures are NOT Allowed*
